title: Optimal Control of RKHS Diffeomorphic Flows for Classification and Generative Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.23497v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop a unified optimal-control framework that solves supervised classification and likelihood-based density estimation with a single diffeomorphic flow whose velocity lives in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS); the two tasks share all structure except the objective. Variable projection eliminates the terminal model (a classifier, or a Gaussian-mixture (GMM) reference), leaving a reduced control problem whose gradient comes from an analytic discrete adjoint. The RKHS parameterization makes the flow's divergence exact and deterministic at the cost of one kernel matrix-vector product, avoiding the stochastic trace estimators and potential-flow restrictions of existing continuous normalizing flows. Because the objective and gradient are deterministic, matrix-free reduced Gauss-Newton (GN) and related second-order solvers are practical for both tasks, which we benchmark against a range of first- and second-order optimizers; th

translated_title: 基于RKHS微分同胚流的最优控制用于分类与生成建模
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个统一的最优控制框架，利用速度场位于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中的单一微分同胚流，同时解决监督分类和基于似然的密度估计问题；这两个任务共享所有结构，仅目标函数不同。变量投影方法消除了终端模型（分类器或高斯混合模型（GMM）参考），从而得到一个降阶控制问题，其梯度来自解析的离散伴随方程。RKHS参数化使得流的散度精确且确定，其代价仅是一次核矩阵-向量乘积，避免了现有连续归一化流中的随机迹估计器和势流限制。由于目标函数和梯度都是确定性的，无矩阵的降阶高斯-牛顿（GN）及相关二阶求解器对这两个任务都切实可行；我们将其与一系列一阶和二阶优化器进行了基准测试。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的最优控制框架，用RKHS参数化的微分同胚流同时解决分类与密度估计任务，其精确且确定性的散度使得二阶优化器切实可行，同时避免了现有连续归一化流的随机迹估计和势流限制。
en_tdlr: A unified optimal-control framework solves both classification and density estimation with RKHS-parameterized diffeomorphic flows, whose exact and deterministic divergence enables practical second-order solvers while avoiding the stochastic trace estimators and potential-flow restrictions of existing continuous normalizing flows.
